Status.note: The EIA-860M table for September 2026, released October 23, 2026, lists Sumpter plant 7972, generator 1, as operating with 85.0 MW nameplate and an operating date of July 2002. It shows no planned retirement. The file is at https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/xls/september_generator2026.xlsx.

Capacity (MW).note: The EIA-860M table for September 2026 gives 85.0 MW nameplate for generator 1 at plant 7972. The file is at https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/xls/september_generator2026.xlsx. The 2023 state air permit staff report calls the turbines 83 MW nominal, so 85.0 MW from the federal table is kept.

Equipment Manufacturer/Model.note: The Michigan air permit staff report from December 2023 at https://mienviro.michigan.gov/ncore/downloadpdf/2275773989853478737 says the plant's main emission sources are four General Electric PG7121 (EA) simple cycle combustion turbines burning pipeline natural gas, owned by Wolverine Power Supply Cooperative. It lists the four turbines as units 1 to 4, so this applies to unit 1.

units.notes: Unit 1 is still listed as operating in the EIA table for September 2026. A web search found no retirement, mothballing or sale news for the plant. I did not find a document naming the operator.
